Gary the owner is an easy-going person who you can quickly get along with. His enthusiasm and helpfulness stand out and his team’s ability to get jobs done is excellent. Totally trustworthy and do not have any hesitation in recommending the team for almost any garden work including irrigation systems.

You will not be disappointed.

about.heading: A local team that treats your garden
about.paragraphs:
GM Garden Landscapes started in 2009 with one van, a digger and a simple idea: do proper landscaping, properly. No disappearing halfway through a job, no mess left behind.

Today we're a tight team of qualified landscapers based in Ferndown, covering Bournemouth, Poole and the surrounding towns — but the standard hasn't changed. Every project gets a real design, a fixed timeline and a 12-month workmanship guarantee.

quote.heading: Let's price up your project.
quote.intro: Tell us a little about your garden and we'll be in touch to book your free site visit. It takes about 60 seconds.

faqs.question: How much does a new patio cost?
faqs.answer: Every garden is different, so we price each job properly rather than quoting a rate per square metre. What moves the price is access to the garden, the materials you choose, how much preparation the area needs, the location, and whether any plant or equipment has to be hired in. We visit, measure up and give you a fixed written quote — free, with no obligation.

faqs.question: Do you offer free quotes?
faqs.answer: Yes — every quote is free and no-obligation. We visit, measure up, discuss options and follow up with a clear fixed price within a week. No pressure and no charge for the visit.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: It varies with the size and complexity of the project, the ground conditions and the access we have to work with. We set out a realistic timeline in your written quote before anything starts, so you know where you stand.

faqs.question: Are you insured?
faqs.answer: Yes — we carry £1m public liability insurance and are a registered waste carrier, so all spoil and waste is removed and disposed of legally. We can provide our waste carrier registration number on request.

faqs.question: Do you use subcontractors?
faqs.answer: The landscaping itself is done by our own team. For specialist work such as electrics and plumbing we bring in trusted trades we have worked with for years — but we manage the project from start to finish and stay accountable for it.

faqs.question: What areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We are based in Ferndown and cover roughly a 30-mile radius — including Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Wimborne, Verwood, Wareham and the surrounding towns. If you are just outside, ask anyway.

faqs.question: Do you offer a guarantee?
faqs.answer: Yes — all our hard landscaping comes with a 12-month workmanship guarantee, set out in writing in your quote. Planting is not covered by a guarantee, as how well plants establish depends on aftercare, weather and soil conditions we cannot control.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Either call us on 07515 341284 or fill in the quick quote form on this page. We will be in touch to book your free site visit, and your written quote will follow within a week.
